Thick_Mycelial_Root_Tentacles.description: Enveloped in a writhing mass of thick, resilient mycelial fibers, these fungal tentacles pulse with dark energy, enhancing the entity's strength and reach while granting it the ability to burrow and climb with ease, their regenerative nature allowing them to swiftly recover from damage.

Toxic_Spores_Weeping_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the shadowy undergrowth, the Weeping Tendrils are long, sinuous fungal appendages that secrete a thick, toxic ooze, capable of launching spore-laden clouds that poison the air around them, while their powerful grasp can ensnare and drag prey into the dark heart of the forest.

Cordyceps_Grasping_Vines.description: Emerging from the host's back, these writhing fungal tentacles are both a blessing and a curse, granting incredible dexterity and reach as they extend and retract, allowing the entity to scale sheer surfaces with ease and ensnare prey or foes with deadly precision.

Slime_Mold_Engulfing_Pseudopods.description: The Slime Mold Engulfing Pseudopods are a writhing mass of fungal tentacles, each one capable of independent movement and rapid adaptation, allowing the entity to climb sheer surfaces and swim through viscous environments with ease, while also granting it the ability to ignore terrain penalties and grapple foes with eerie precision.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Tendrils.description: The entity's ghostly tendrils, pulsating with otherworldly light, extend from its fungal body, enhancing its magical perception and wisdom, granting it the ability to illuminate darkened paths and detect hidden arcane signatures.

Decaying_Rot_Wood_Branch_Tentacles.description: The Decaying Rot Wood Branch Tentacles are gnarled, fungal growths that resemble withered tree limbs, their surface covered in a sickly green mold that emits a noxious, choking spore cloud. These tentacles, though crude in appearance, possess an unnatural resilience and strength, allowing them to ensnare prey with ease while instilling dread in anyone who dares to look upon them.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Blade_Tentacles.description: Embedded within the gnarled, fungal tendrils that sprout from the creature's armored body are razor-sharp blades, each tentacle a conduit of relentless assault and fortification, imbuing the wielder with an aura of resilience and the ability to inflict prolonged agony upon their foes.

Vibrant_Amanita_Poison_Whips.description: Emerging from the pulsating, fungal flesh of the creature, the Vibrant Amanita Poison Whips are a mesmerizing blend of bioluminescent hues and eerie grace, capable of ensnaring foes with their toxic touch and unleashing a choking cloud of venomous spores.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the obsidian soil of the Underdark, the crystalline tendrils of this fungal entity shimmer with an eerie, bioluminescent glow, their sharp, crystalline tips reflecting the dark magic that surrounds them, granting enhanced wisdom and constitution to those who wield them.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Tendrils.description: Spectral tendrils, akin to ghostly fungal tentacles, whisper through the shadows, granting their host an eerie stealth and ethereal sight, allowing them to blend into the darkness and navigate realms unseen by the living.
